import requests
import uuid
import sys
import time

BASE = "{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}"
HEADERS = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}

# Generate unique class name
class_name = "TestMaxConnBelowMin" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]

# Test: vectorIndexConfig.maxConnections=3 (below minimum, should be rejected)
payload = {
    "class": class_name,
    "vectorIndexConfig": {
        "maxConnections": 3
    }
}

print(f"Creating class {class_name} with vectorIndexConfig.maxConnections=3...")
resp = requests.post(f"{BASE}/v1/schema", json=payload, headers=HEADERS)
print(f"Status: {resp.status_code}, Body: {resp.text}")

if resp.status_code == 200:
    print("[DEFECT: ILLEGAL_SUCCESS] Server accepted vectorIndexConfig.maxConnections=3 which should be rejected")
    # Clean up
    requests.delete(f"{BASE}/v1/schema/{class_name}", headers=HEADERS)
    sys.exit(1)
else:
    print(f"OK: Server correctly rejected vectorIndexConfig.maxConnections=3 with status {resp.status_code}")
    sys.exit(0)
